reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and the listing gives me a width and three color temperatures but no lumens, no UL listing, no canopy size or install details, which my electrician needs before I spend $360 on a fixture. With no retailer track record, I'm not putting a large fixture at risk on a 6-week lead time.
objection: If it arrives wrong, too big or looks cheap, I pay return shipping on a big boxed fixture myself, and I can't tell whether it's UL listed or what the real specs are.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with lumens, UL/ETL listing, canopy and weight and install details, plus free return shipping (or a prepaid return label) and real independent reviews with photos from owners.
